deploy.preDeployCommand: cd backend && /opt/venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput && /opt/venv/bin/python     manage.py check_deployment --role all --skip-media-write-probe
deploy.startCommand: /opt/venv/bin/python backend/manage.py check_deployment --role all && /opt/venv/bin/python backend/manage.py migrate --noinput && /opt/venv/bin/honcho start -f Procfile
